items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Skeak came up with a Rupneck's job, and here I am, involved in a jazz band.

ctx.x: For a small group. And I'm following him,

one man. So it didn't work out. Two weeks, I found out I couldn't do a single, there wasn't a jazz joint special. So I came back to Chicago and Skeak came up with a Rupneck's job, and here I am, involved in a jazz band. And again, it turned out to be all white, either Skeak's doing or -- I don't know. Chicago was not against me having a mixed band at the Blue Note. But, again, they told me, in Chicago you ask questions and go halfway.
And I know that Lee Collins, they were jamming with Lee Collins here and there. But there was still strictly white bands and black bands.
